issues: Key point 3 mixes up the recommendation. The article recommends codeunit 49's integration events instead of subscribing directly to system codeunits. It suggests table-specific mechanisms only when the set of tables is known.
The summary names only Global Triggers, but the rule covers two events: GetDatabaseTableTriggerSetup on Global Triggers and OnAfterGetDatabaseTableTriggerSetup on codeunit 49.
The page says 'AL versions 15'. The description only says 'Applicable versions: 15 and later', so the key point should not add 'AL'.
